{{Top|leg}}
'''Yggon''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Yggon commented on the entry for the [[Plasma cutter/Legends|plasma cutter]], recommending that shooting the [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] canister of the tool turn it into an improvised bomb.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
